declarations.description: Progressively enhances an associated label and file input with a Light DOM drag-and-drop surface, accessible announcements, and optional image previews.
declarations.name: FormDropzoneElement

attributes.name: drop-label
attributes.description: Drop instruction inserted before the author-provided label.

attributes.name: separator-label
attributes.description: Text inserted between the drop instruction and label.

attributes.name: received-message
attributes.description: Live-region template for accepted files. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: rejected-type-message
attributes.default: "Rejected because the file type is not accepted: {files}."
attributes.description: Live-region template for files rejected by accept. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: rejected-multiple-message
attributes.default: "Rejected because only one file is allowed: {files}."
attributes.description: Live-region template for excess files on a single-file input. Supports {files} and {count}.

attributes.name: preview-images
attributes.description: Renders accepted image selections in a Light DOM preview grid.
